Plot simulated outcomes over time

Source: R/plot1_plotly.R
plot1_plotly.Rd

Draws interactive plots of daily and cumulative infection, quarantine and outreach outcomes for students and household adults.

Usage

plot1_plotly(
  class_records,
  average_class_data_by_day = summarize_records(class_records),
  plot3_ymax = 5,
  plot4_ymax = plot3_ymax,
  plot5_ymax = 3,
  x1 = 0,
  x2 = 0.5,
  x3 = 0.5
)

Arguments

class_records

the class_records element of the list returned by run_simulation()

average_class_data_by_day

daily summaries of class_records, as returned by summarize_records()

plot3_ymax

minimum upper limit of the y-axis for student infection rates

plot4_ymax

minimum upper limit of the y-axis for household adult infection rates

plot5_ymax

minimum upper limit of the y-axis for quarantine and outreach outcomes

x1, x2, x3

currently unused

Value

a plotly figure
